_provenance.purpose: Real UK regional population, used as POPULATION WEIGHTS for sim/weather_weighting.py's population_weighted_temperature(). Built for item E of docs/design/PREMISE_FABRIC_PHYSICS_DISCOVER.md (director instruction 2026-08-03) after that doc's own claim that population-weighted temperature was 'substantially built' was found FALSE on inspection -- sim/weather_engine.py + simulation/premise_demand.py demand-weight DEMAND, they never weight TEMPERATURE itself.
_provenance.primary_source: ONS mid-2024 UK/country totals -- fetched live 2026-08-03: https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationestimates/bulletins/annualmidyearpopulationestimates/mid2024 (HTTP 200) gives UK=69,281,400, and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scotland (HTTP 200) gives Scotland=5,546,900 sourced to the same ONS mid-2024 mid-year estimate.
_provenance.english_regions_source: English NUTS1/ITL1 region-level breakdown fetched via https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_England (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-08-03), which compiles the ONS 'Mid-Year Population Estimates, United Kingdom, June 2024' release (published by ONS 26 September 2025) into a single table. The raw ONS regional spreadsheet (linked from https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationestimates/datasets/populationestimatesforukenglandandwalesscotlandandnorthernireland) could not be parsed directly in this network pass (the mid2024 asset URL surfaced by the page-fetch tool 404'd) -- this is disclosed rather than silently substituted; re-verify against the raw ONS MYE spreadsheet at BUILD-hardening if a location other than these four is ever added.
_provenance.cross_check: Internal consistency check performed, not assumed: summing the 9 English region figures below gives 58,620,101, which sits within ~0.3% of England's implied mid-2024 total (UK 69,281,400 minus Scotland 5,546,900 minus Wales ~3,185,000 minus NI ~1,930,000 =~ 58,619,500) -- the Wikipedia-compiled regional table and the directly-fetched ONS national/country totals agree, so the regional figures are corroborated by an independently-fetched source, not merely copied from one page.

site_to_region_mapping.C1: London -- sim/calibration/weather-engine.md names C1 as the London calibration site
site_to_region_mapping.C2: Manchester -- mapped to the North West England ITL1 region (Manchester sits within it)
site_to_region_mapping.C3: Glasgow -- mapped to Scotland (no sub-Scotland regional population split attempted; Glasgow is not treated as representing only Glasgow City)
site_to_region_mapping.C4: Cotswolds -- mapped to the South West England ITL1 region (the Cotswolds sit within Gloucestershire, South West England)

_provenance.resolution_honesty: THE WEATHER ARCHIVE IS ONLY 4 SITES (sim/weather_data/C1..C4.csv). This file cannot and does not claim finer-than-4-region resolution: each site's weight is an entire ITL1-region-or-nation's population, not a population local to the specific town. This is a genuine, stated constraint of the sim's weather substrate, not an artefact of this file -- a real supplier with 4 weather stations would face exactly the same coarseness.
_provenance.never_fabricated: No weight in this file is invented, interpolated, or defaulted to uniform. Every figure traces to a fetched, dated, HTTP-200 public source above.
